title: Tens of thousands of alien satellites studying Earth before Sputnik

tellings.quote: that tens of thousands of alien satellites were studying our planet before we could even launch one of our own.

plain: Tens of thousands of alien satellites are said to have been studying Earth before 1957, the year Sputnik became the first human-made satellite. Michels frames it this way in his interview with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, as what her work could suggest. If true, something non-human would have been watching the planet before we could launch anything of our own.
